command:
set -euo pipefail
VIS=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual; BR=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/local_bridge_state/repo; C=e8d09af9b3fb3df9020ee3956111f3ba99a1ce5d
cd "$VIS"; test "$(hostname)" = ai-core-node-projekt-frankenstein; test "$(sha256sum buehne_daemon.py|awk '{print $1}')" = 5527a1510e4101bcd97a9f57317580638757485d929a9b8e68c3d0ea9d91fcd2; test "$(sha256sum buehne.html|awk '{print $1}')" = 18770d8e333af1bc49a818da4dbd5c2e482b859e0142d0213df6c956184c931e; test "$(systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-buehne.service)" = active
TMP=$(mktemp -d /var/tmp/blink-stage-XXXXXX); BACKUP="$VIS/.go_backups/blink-pre-20260912T0723-cache-aware"; test ! -e "$BACKUP"; mkdir "$BACKUP"; cp -a augen_blink/blink_*.png "$BACKUP/"
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
git -C "$BR" show "$C:handoff/frank-avatar-round2-candidate/build_blink_eye_local_mask.py" > "$TMP/build.py"; python3 "$TMP/build.py" "$VIS" "$TMP/out" >/dev/null; cp -a "$TMP"/out/blink_*.png augen_blink/
for f in "$TMP"/out/blink_*.png; do n=$(basename "$f"); test "$(sha256sum "$f"|awk '{print $1}')" = "$(sha256sum "augen_blink/$n"|awk '{print $1}')"; done
echo STAGE_LOCAL_HASHES=PASS; sha256sum augen_blink/blink_*.png | sort
systemd-run --user --unit=go-avatar-blink-restart-20260912-0723 --on-active=2s /usr/bin/systemctl --user restart frankenstein-buehne.service >/dev/null
echo BACKUP=$BACKUP; echo RESTART_SCHEDULED=1
